why: Bare 'charge' first evokes a fee, an accusation, or an electric charge; French charge means a load/burden or a responsibility (负担；职责；装载).
Bare 'to live' first evokes being alive (French vivre); habiter means to reside/dwell somewhere (居住；住在).

new_en: to watch over, supervise, keep an eye on
why: Bare 'watch' first evokes passively watching TV (regarder); surveiller means to supervise/monitor/guard (监视；监督；看管).
Bare 'light' first evokes illumination (the lumière sense); this adjective means not heavy / slight / mild (轻的；轻微的；清淡的).

new_en: to move along, circulate, get around
why: Bare 'drive' first evokes operating a car (conduire); circuler means traffic/blood/rumors moving and circulating (行驶；流通；传播).
Bare 'strike' first evokes hitting or a military/baseball strike; French grève is specifically a labor work stoppage (罢工).

new_en: to host (a show or event), lead, enliven
why: Bare 'lead' first evokes leadership/guiding; animer primarily means to host/present and to enliven (主持；使充满活力；激励).
Bare 'firm' first evokes the adjective (solid/steady); French firme is the noun for a company/business (公司；企业).

new_en: to travel across, cover (a distance); skim, browse (a text)
why: Bare 'cover' first evokes putting a cover over something; parcourir means to traverse a distance or to skim/browse a text (走遍，穿越；浏览，翻阅).
Bare 'mine' first evokes an excavation/ore mine (cf. entry 1403); mien is the emphatic possessive meaning 'mine' (我的).
